summary.text: Rusty Cornwell is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 6 and has served since the 57th Legislature. He has lived in Craig County since 1986 and owns and operates several businesses.

paragraphs.text: Cornwell and his wife, Sherri, operate a 1,140-acre ranch and hunting facility in western Craig County and live on a smaller farm in southern Craig County.
They have two daughters and six grandchildren, all living in northeast Oklahoma.
Cornwell is a member of the Vinita and Oologah chambers of commerce and of Whitetails of Oklahoma, and he previously served as vice president of the Vinita Rotary Club.
His House page says he is involved with several veteran groups to provide outdoor activities for veterans.
He served as Majority Caucus Vice Chair in the 58th Legislature and Assistant Majority Whip in the 59th.
